mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 6.5% over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer demand and corporate earnings, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 6.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over two consecutive quarters signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of two-quarter RSAFS declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average by more than 2% signals improving manufacturing activity, which boosts earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when INDPRO > 12-month MA + 2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in both the federal funds rate and consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 3% signals a tightening monetary regime with elevated inflation, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when both FEDFUNDS > 3% and CPIAUCSL > 3% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in both the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and payrolls (PAYEMS) over three months signals a labor market normalization after a recession, which improves hiring flexibility and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises AND PAYEMS rises over three months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of both rising UNRATE and PAYEMS (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the housing starts index (HOUST) above its 12-month moving average by more than 5% signals improving residential investment, which boosts construction sector earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when HOUST > 12-month MA + 5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average by more than 3% signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when INDPRO < 12-month MA - 3% (t-test p > 0.05).
